original.target_description: Study 4, university undergraduates imagining victims or perpetrators in a workplace vignette; willingness to reconcile after an acceptance versus empowerment message; Role × Message interaction in the after condition (2 × 2 between-subjects ANOVA).

notes: Published article title, authors, year and DOI match the assigned reference. Source version: published article supplied by licensed EBSCO PsycInfo service. The supplied p. 14 locator corresponds to PDF p. 14 / printed p. 129. Target selected as the after-message Role × Message interaction because the neutral description specifies reconciliation following the messages. The same paragraph separately reports the Time × Message × Role interaction, F(1, 90) = 6.43, p < .05, η² = .07; that is a distinct test and is not combined with the extracted after-condition p value. Analytic N is supported by the Study 4 participant count, Table 5 N and matching ANOVA degrees of freedom; no N was calculated from the degrees of freedom. Replication and author success verdict were not examined, as required for an original-only target.
